forBeginners.stepsTitle: How You Go Start As Beginner
forBeginners.step1Desc: Create your account for 30 seconds. Select "Beginner" as your English level. Na that one — no test, no pressure.

forBeginners.tip2Desc: Talk about your name, your country, your hobbies, the weather. Simple topics na the best way to start.

forBeginners.tip4Desc: Pay attention to how your partner dey talk. Try new words and phrases. Na that one be how you go improve sharp sharp.

forBeginners.faq2Answer: Small one dey fine, but try speak English as much as possible. Even simple English better pass perfect native language.
